title: Cache-to-Cache: Direct Semantic Communication Between Large Language Models
authors: Tianyu Fu; Zihan Min; Hanling Zhang; Jichao Yan; Guohao Dai; Wanli Ouyang; Yu Wang
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Infinigence AI, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, SLAI, Shanghai AI Laboratory

problem_statement.en: Existing multi-LLM systems exchange semantics through text, forcing high-dimensional internal representations into lossy linear token sequences and incurring sequential decoding latency. This bottleneck prevents models with different knowledge or roles from directly sharing complementary contextual understanding.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 multi-LLM 系統透過 text 交換語意，迫使高維內部 representation 壓縮為有損的線性 token sequence，並承擔循序 decoding latency。此瓶頸使具備不同知識或角色的模型無法直接共享互補的 context 理解。

key_innovation.en: C2C trains lightweight per-layer neural fusers that align heterogeneous tokenizers and layers, project a Sharer's KV cache into a Receiver's representation space, and fuse it residually with the Receiver cache. Learnable per-layer gates select where to inject the transferred semantics while both LLMs remain frozen.
key_innovation.zh: C2C 訓練輕量的逐 layer neural fuser，對齊異質 tokenizer 與 layer，將 Sharer 的 KV cache 投影至 Receiver 的 representation space，再以 residual 方式與 Receiver cache 融合。可學習的逐 layer gate 選擇注入所傳遞語意的位置，且兩個 LLM 均保持凍結。

key_improvements.en: Across the evaluated model pairings, C2C achieves 6.4–14.2% higher average accuracy than individual models and 3.1–5.4% higher average accuracy than T2T communication, with an average 2.5× latency speedup.
key_improvements.zh: 在所評測的 model pairing 中，C2C 的平均 accuracy 較 individual model 提升 6.4–14.2%，較 T2T communication 提升 3.1–5.4%，且 latency 平均加速 2.5×。

reuse_metric.en: Average accuracy is the reported reuse/communication-quality metric: C2C improves it by 6.4–14.2% over individual models and by 3.1–5.4% over T2T communication.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文以平均 accuracy 作為重用／通訊品質指標：C2C 較 individual model 提升 6.4–14.2%，並較 T2T communication 提升 3.1–5.4%。
